mapper.sql: s.session_id, s.session_type, s.inquiry_id, s.user1_id, s.user2_id, s.last_message, s.last_message_time, s.user1_unread, s.user2_unread, s.status, s.assigned_admin_id, s.business_type, s.business_id, s.business_name, s.created_at, s.updated_at
LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON s.user1_id = u1.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON COALESCE(s.assigned_admin_id, s.user2_id) = u2.user_id
u1.nick_name AS user1_name, u2.nick_name AS user2_name, u1.avatar AS user1_avatar, u2.avatar AS user2_avatar
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_chat_session (session_type, inquiry_id, user1_id, user2_id, user1_unread, user2_unread, status, business_type, business_id, business_name, assigned_admin_id, created_at) VALUES (#{sessionType}, #{inquiryId}, #{user1Id}, #{user2Id}, 0, 0, 0, #{businessType}, #{businessId}, #{businessName}, #{assignedAdminId}, NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT , FROM sys_chat_session s
WHERE s.session_id = #{sessionId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sys_chat_session s WHERE s.session_id = #{sessionId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_chat_session SET assigned_admin_id = #{adminId} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.select:
SELECT , FROM sys_chat_session s
WHERE (s.user1_id = #{userId} OR s.user2_id = #{userId})
AND s.status IN (0, 1)AND s.status = #{status}
ORDER BY s.last_message_time DESC, s.created_at DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE sys_chat_session
SET user1_unread = user1_unread + 1
SET user2_unread = user2_unread + 1
WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}

UPDATE sys_chat_session
SET user1_unread = 0
SET user2_unread = 0
WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE sys_chat_session SET status = #{status} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(nick_name, ''), user_name) FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS nickName, u.avatar AS avatar FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.status = '0' AND r.del_flag = '0' WHERE u.user_type = '00' AND u.status = '0' AND u.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.avatar ORDER BY u.user_id
